architecturalPlan.scaleRationale: A 160 m² enclosed single-level villa is selected to give credible exterior envelope capacity for three bedrooms while keeping the tropical residence compact, calm and landscape-oriented; no budget or site dimensions were provided, so this is a design assumption rather than an area formula.
architecturalPlan.arrivalAndCirculation: The public approach runs from the front arrival path to a recessed central entrance at the ground-floor walking datum of Y=0.20 m, while the private three-bedroom capacity is reserved behind the same protected envelope and service fit-out is deferred.
architecturalPlan.volumeHierarchy: A 16.0 × 10.0 m primary living-and-bedroom volume has a floor-top datum of Y=0.20 m, 3.40 m enclosure height and a thin flat roof at Y=3.72 m; the lower 12.0 × 5.0 m terrace canopy is deliberately subordinate at a 3.20 m underside datum.
architecturalPlan.relationshipsAndViews: The entrance faces the arrival court on the positive-Z side, broad garden-facing openings and the shaded terrace face the pool on the negative-Z side, and a continuous dry terrace-to-pool-deck route is held outside the water footprint.
architecturalPlan.roofFacadeAndMaterials: Warm ivory enclosure walls, bronze-framed glazed bays, timber shade posts and limestone pool paving establish a modern tropical palette, with deep flat roof edges, a freestanding terrace canopy, more open garden elevations and smaller side openings for shade and privacy.

commitments.description: A real central exterior entrance is cut into the front enclosure and reached by a level path and threshold.
The primary one-storey residential envelope reserves shared exterior capacity for the requested three bedrooms, with detailed internal subdivision deferred.
The rear terrace is roofed by an independently supported shallow canopy and connects directly to the pool's near dry deck.
The pool is a rectangular constructed basin with floor, enclosing walls, coping, water and surrounding dry decks.

name: Palm Court Tropical Villa
summary: A single-level modern tropical villa pairs a deeply edged ivory residence with a shaded timber-and-bronze terrace, formal arrival path and rectangular garden pool. Exterior envelope, openings, entrance, terrace structure and pool basin are constructed; interiors remain intentionally unfinished.
unsupported: Interior bedroom walls, bathroom layouts, kitchen fit-out, furnishings and detailed service spaces are deferred; the shared envelope only reserves accommodation capacity for three bedrooms.
The requested tropical planting is not modelled because direct scene output has no editable planting or tree primitive.
The pool has a rectangular basin, water, coping and dry access only; infinity edge hydraulics, lighting, filtration, drainage and pool equipment are not represented.
The site is generated as a temporary flat Y=0 ground plane because site survey, orientation, drainage and terrain information were not supplied.
Structural, wind, corrosion, waterproofing, code and hurricane-performance certification are outside the scene capability.
